flags.why: “Nói queo sự việc” is unnatural Vietnamese; the established construction for distorting a story is “bẻ queo” ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-queo)).
flags.fix: Họ bẻ queo câu chuyện để đổ lỗi cho tôi. = They twisted the story to put the blame on me.

flags.why: “Mềm mỏng” describes gentle, tactful speech or behaviour, not the physical pliancy of branches or materials ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-m%E1%BB%81m%20m%E1%BB%8Fng)).
